label: dgx-spark-optimization-research-complete
context: Completed comprehensive research on DGX Spark Qwen3.6-35B-A3B BF16 optimization. Scanned NVIDIA Developer Forums (7 threads), Reddit r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub repos, NVIDIA blog, Qwen docs, TurboQuant paper. Key finding: stock vLLM image has CMake bug that omits SM121 kernels, causing 3.65x performance penalty (13 vs 49 tok/s). Full optimization stack documented in 7 layers: SM121 kernels (3.65x), MTP-3 (+25-40%), FP8 KV+prefix caching (+5-10%), DFlash/LSTM (long ctx), FlashInfer (+5-10%), HF Kernels Hub (1.7-2.5x MoE), GPU clock (+15%). NVFP4 CONFIRMED BROKEN on SM121. TurboQuant expands capacity not speed. Community-verified benchmarks: single Spark FP8 ~52-54 tok/s, BF16 ~40-49 tok/s with MTP-3, dual Spark FP8 ~77.7 tok/s. Updated skill to v2.0. Saved comprehensive knowledge file.
